title: Offline scene readiness and timebase
prompt: A fixed-timeline product film requests an exact frame rate of 30000/1001 and 300 frames. The export waits two seconds after page load, accepts fallback fonts, captures before an image decodes, and renders frames 0 through 300 inclusive. Video textures seek backward by setting currentTime, without confirming the presented frame. Diagnose the contract and give acceptance evidence. Do not run tools or change files.

checks.reason: Routing-level signal only; assess reasoning and evidence through the rubric.

rubric: Requires bounded, named readiness checks and verifies required assets rather than silent fallback or fixed sleep.
Keeps the rational rate, frame domain 0 through 299, and duration 300 times 1001/30000 seconds; does not add an endpoint frame.
Distinguishes requested media seek time from decoded/presented media frame evidence and handles backward seeks.
Keeps frame-order readiness and export verification separate from animation performance or arbitrary 60 fps requirements.
acceptance: The response makes the justified decisions, identifies discriminating project-level checks, and states evidence limits without inventing execution. Static validation and keyword matching do not prove runtime behavior.
